Name: Cats that Cluck
Author: ForgedBrass
Description:
Have a Pet Replacer that replaces the Cat with a Chicken, or just wonder what it would be like to have a Cat that Clucks like a Chicken? Use this Mod to change the sound that Cats make into the sound that Chickens make.

Credit to: [url=https://github.com/Traehgniw]Traehgniw[/url]﻿ for the idea for this mod.

Manifest.Name: Cats That Cluck
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Cat Meowing Sound with Chicken Noises
Manifest.Author: Forged Brass
